verses.sanskrit:
धृष्टद्युम्न उवाच।
              दुर्योधनो दुर्विषहो दुर्मुखो दुष्प्रधर्षणः। विविंशतिर्विकर्णश्च सहो दुःशासनस्तथा॥१॥
verses.english: Dhrishtadyumna said : Duryodhana, Durvishaha, Durmukha, Dushpradharshana, Vivignshati, Vikarna, Saha, Dushasana,

verses.sanskrit: युयुत्सुर्वायुवेगश्च भीमवेगरवस्तथा। उग्रायुधो बलाकी च करकायुर्विरोचनः॥२॥
verses.english: Yuyutsu, Vayuvega, Bhima, Vegarava, Ugrayudha, Balaki, Karakayu, Virochana,

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डकश्चित्रसेनश्च सुवर्चाः कनकध्वजः। नन्दको बाहुशाली च तुहुण्डो विकटस्तथा॥३॥
verses.english: Sukundala, Chitrasena, Suvarcha, Kanakadhvaja, Nandaka, Bahushali, Tuhunda, Vikata,

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवो धार्तराष्ट्रा महाबलाः। कर्णेन सहिता वीरास्त्वदर्थं समुपागताः॥४॥
verses.english: These and others are the greatly powerful sons of Dhritarashtra. These heroes have all come with Karna for your hands.

verses.sanskrit: असङ्ख्याता महात्मानः पार्थिवाः क्षत्रियर्षभाः। शकुनिः सौबलश्चैव वृषकोऽथ बृहद्बलः॥५॥
verses.english: Numerous other illustrious kings, the best of Kshatriyas,. (have also come for you). Shakuni, Saybala, Vrishaka, Brihadbala,

verses.sanskrit: एते गान्धारराजस्य सुताः सर्वे समागताः। अश्वत्थामा च भोजश्च सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरौ॥६॥
verses.english: These sons of the king of Gandhara have also come. The foremost of all wielders of arms, Ashvathama and Bhoja.

verses.sanskrit: समवेतौ महात्मानौ त्वदर्थे समलङ्कृतौ। बृहन्तो मणिमांश्चैव दण्डधारश्च पार्थिवः॥७॥
verses.english: Have come hero adorned with every ornament. The kings, Brihanta, Manimana, Dandadhara,

verses.sanskrit: सहदेवजयत्सेनौ मेघसन्धिश्च पार्थिवः। विराटः सह पुत्राभ्यां शङ्खेनैवोत्तरेण च॥८॥
verses.english: Sahadeva, Jayatsena, Meghasandhi, Virata with his two sons, Sankhya and Uttara,

verses.sanskrit: वार्धक्षेमिः सुशर्मा च सेनाबिन्दुश्च पार्थिवः। सुकेतुः सह पुत्रेण सुनाम्ना च सुवर्चसा॥९॥
verses.english: Vardhakshemi, Susharma, Senabindu, Suketu with his two sons, Sunamana and Suvarcha,

verses.sanskrit: सुचित्रः सुकुमारश्च वृकः सत्यधृतिस्तथा। सूर्यध्वजो रोचमानो नीलश्चित्रायुधस्तथा॥१०॥
verses.english: Suchitra, Sukumara, Vrika, Satyadhriti, Suryadhvaja, Rochamana, Nila, Chitrayudha,

verses.sanskrit: अंशुमांश्चेकितानश्च श्रेणिमांश्च महाबलः। समुद्रसेनपुत्रश्च चन्द्रसेनः प्रतापवान्॥११॥
verses.english: Angshumana, Chekitana, the mighty Srinimana, Chandrasena, the son of the mighty Subhadrasena both the father and the son,

verses.sanskrit: जलसन्धः पितापुत्रौ विदण्डो दण्ड एव च। पौण्ड्रको वासुदेवश्च भगदत्तश्च वीर्यवान्॥१२॥
verses.english: Jalasandha, Vidanda, Danda, Paundraka, Vasudeva, the mighty Bhagadatta,

verses.sanskrit: कलिङ्गस्ताम्रलिप्तश्च पत्तनाधिपतिस्तथा। मद्रराजस्तथा शल्यः सहपुत्रो महारथः॥१३॥
verses.english: Kalinga, Tamralipta, the king of Pattana, the king of Madra, the great car-warrior Shalya with his son,

verses.sanskrit: रुक्माङ्गदेन वीरेण तथा रुक्मरथेन च। कौरव्यः सोमदत्तश्च पुत्रश्चास्य महारथः॥१४॥
verses.english: The heroic Rukmangada, Rukmaratha, Somadatta of the Kuru race with his three sons,

verses.sanskrit: समवेतास्त्रयः शूरा भूरिर्भूरिश्रवाः शलः। सुदक्षिणश्च काम्बोजो दृढधन्वा च पौरवः॥१५॥
verses.english: All great heroic and car-warriors, all these have assembled here. Bhuri, Bhurishrava, Sala, Sudakshina, Kamboja, the Paurava Dridadhnava,

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्बलः सुषेणश्च शिबिरौशीनस्तथा। पटच्चरनिहन्ता च कारूषाधिपतिस्तथा॥१६॥
verses.english: Brihadbala, Sushena, Shibi, the son of Ushinara, Pataccharnihanta, the king of Karusha,

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कर्षणो वासुदेवो रौक्मिणेयश्च वीर्यवान्। साम्बश्च चारुदेष्णश्च प्राद्युम्निः सगदस्तथा॥१७॥
verses.english: Sankarshana, (Baladeva) Vasudeva (Krishna), the mighty son of Rukmini, Samba, Charudeshna, the son of Pradyumna, Gada,

verses.sanskrit: अक्रूरः सात्यकिश्चैव उद्धवश्च महामतिः। कृतवर्मा च हार्दिक्यः पृथुर्विपृथुरेव च॥१८॥
verses.english: Akrura, Satyaki, the high-souled Uddhava, Kritavarma, the son of Hridika, Pritha, Vipritha,

verses.sanskrit: विदूरथश्च कङ्कश्च शङ्कुश्च सगवेषणः। आशावहोऽनिरुद्धश्च समीकः सारिमेजयः॥१९॥
verses.english: Viduratha, Kamka, Shanku, Gaveshna, Ashavaha, Aniruddha, Shamika, Sarimejaya,

verses.sanskrit: वीरो वातपतिश्चैव झिल्ली पिण्डारकस्तथा। उशीनरश्च विक्रान्तो वृष्णयस्ते प्रकीर्तिताः॥२०॥
verses.english: Heroic Vatapati, Jhilli, Pindaraka, the powerful Ushinara, all these are known as Vrishnis,

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथो बृहत्क्षत्रः सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः। बृहद्रथो बाह्लिकश्च श्रुतायुश्च महारथः॥२१॥
verses.english: Bhagiratha, Brihatkshatra, the son of Sindhu, Jayadratha, Brihadratha, Balhika, the great car-warrior Shrutayu,

verses.sanskrit: उलूकः कैतवो राजा चित्राङ्गदशुभाङ्गदौ। वत्सराजश्च मतिमान्कोसलाधिपतिस्तथा॥२२॥
verses.english: Uluka, Kaitava, Chitrangada, Subhangada, the intelligent Vatsaraja, the king of Kosala,

verses.sanskrit: शिशुपालश्च विक्रान्तो जरासन्धस्तथैव च। एते चान्ये च बहवो नानाजनपदेश्वराः॥२३॥
verses.english: Shishupala, the Powerful Jarasandha, these and many other kings, of many countries,

verses.sanskrit: त्वदर्थमागता भद्रे क्षत्रियाः प्रथिता भुवि। एते भेत्स्यन्ति विक्रान्तास्त्वदर्थे लक्ष्यमुत्तमम्। विध्यते य इदं लक्ष्यं वरयेथाः शुभेऽद्य तम्॥२४॥
verses.english: And all the Kshatriyas celebrated in the world, O amiable sister, have come for your hand. O blessed girl, these powerful men will (try to) shoot the mark. Among these (heroes) you shall choose him as your husband who will (be able to) shoot the mark.
